why: The student fixes this one failing case correctly: (a + b) / 2.0 gives 11 / 2.0 = 5.5. They link the parentheses to the order of operations and the double operand to avoiding integer division. Fixing one given failing case is L3.

concepts.why: Links an operand's type to which division runs: a double divisor makes the int sum widen, so the fraction is kept.

Parentheses override precedence so the sum is computed before the division, unlike a + b / 2.
